title: Pet (Squibbles)
contents: text | You have a tiny pet. It has the minion trait, meaning it gains 2 actions during your turn if you use the <u>Command an Animal</u> action to command it; this replaces the usual effects of Command an Animal, and you don't need to attempt a Nature check. A pet can't take <u>attack</u> actions except to <u>Escape</u> or <u>Force Open</u>.
text | Level Your pet's level is equal to yours.

text | Modifiers and AC Your pet's Saves and AC are equal to yours before applying bonuses or penalties. It uses 3 + your level as its modifier for Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth, and just your level as its modifier for other skill checks. It doesn't have or use its own attribute modifiers and can never benefit from item bonuses.

text | Hit Points Your pet has 5 Hit Points per level.
Senses Your pet has low-light vision and can gain additional senses from pet abilities.
Speed Your pet has a Speed of 25 feet.
Pet Abilities
bullet | Climber It gains a climb Speed of 25 feet.
bullet | Manual Dexterity It can use up to two of its limbs to perform manipulate actions.

text | Special You can replace a pet/gain a new one by spending 1 week of downtime, releasing any previous pet. If you later gain a familiar or other companion that uses the Pet feat, you can immediately retrain this feat.
